info.title: InferHub Integration API
info.summary: One sk-airo- key for inference, account/billing management, and the publisher marketplace.
info.description:
InferHub exposes three surfaces, all authenticated by the **same `sk-airo-` API key**
you use for inference. Send it as `Authorization: Bearer sk-airo-…` (the Anthropic-style
`x-api-key` header is also accepted).

### Surfaces
- **Inference** — `https://api.inferhub.dev` · OpenAI (`/v1/chat/completions`, `/v1/responses`)
  and Anthropic (`/v1/messages`) compatible. Agents and SDKs speak this directly.
- **Management API** — `https://inferhub.dev/api` · keys, billing/deposits, budgets, combos,
  catalog preferences, usage, and the full publisher marketplace (providers, asks, schedule,
  earnings, withdrawals). This is the surface documented in detail below.
- **MCP server** — `https://inferhub.dev/mcp/sse` · the same management functions exposed as
  tools for agents (Claude Code, Cursor, …) over the SSE transport.

### Model name formats (inference)
`"<prefix>/<model>"` (e.g. `ocg/glm-5.2`), `"<alias>"` (e.g. `glm-5`), `"combo/<slug>"`,
or `"free/<slug>/<model>"`. A bare model name with no slash is treated as an alias and routed
cheapest-first across its members.

### Money
All monetary values are USDC, returned as decimal **strings** (e.g. `"12.500000"`). Money-moving
endpoints are idempotent where it matters (deposits by signature, topups by claim) and use atomic
conditional ledger debits so concurrent requests can never overdraw.

### Errors
Errors use `{"error":{"code":"…","message":"…"}}` with a RESTful status
(`400`/`401`/`403`/`404`/`409`/`422`/`429`). Inference errors follow the OpenAI/Anthropic shapes.

bearerAuth.description: Your InferHub API key, format `sk-airo-<24 chars>`. Send as `Authorization: Bearer sk-airo-…`.

200.description: Account profile and current USDC balances by account kind.

delete.description: Irreversible. Revokes all API keys and locks the account in one transaction; ledger/audit trail is preserved.

200.description: A pretty-printed JSON document of the caller's own data (secrets redacted).
Non-revoked keys (metadata only; never the secret).

201.description: Created. The plaintext `secret` is returned exactly once.

post.summary: Rotate an API key (24h grace window)

201.description: New key created; the old key stays valid for 24h then auto-expires. New plaintext `secret` returned once.

get.summary: Get (or derive) my Solana deposit address

200.description: The caller's unique deposit address (pubkey + USDC ATA) for the active network.

post.description: Asks the round-robin scanner to re-check your deposit address on the next tick (~1 min). 5-minute cooldown.

204.description: Queued — the scanner re-checks your address on the next tick (~1 min). No body.

404.description: No deposit address found for this account.

429.description: On cooldown (5 min). The error object carries `retryAfter` (seconds).

post.summary: Instantly credit a USDC deposit by transaction signature
post.description: Verifies the on-chain USDC transfer lands in YOUR deposit ATA, then writes the same idempotent double-entry the worker does.

200.description: Credited (or already credited). `amount` is USDC as a 6-decimal string.
10 most recent top-ups (QRIS/PayPal) for the authenticated consumer, newest first.

amountUsdc.description: USDC amount credited on payment, as a decimal string e.g. "12.500000".

amountIdr.description: IDR amount to pay (integer rupiah, including QRIS unique suffix).

paymentUrl.description: Provider payment page URL, or null.

topupKey.description: Public top-up key ("ih-topup-" + uuid), or null.

200.description: Top-up created; balance credits asynchronously on payment. Returns QR payload / PayPal URL.

get.summary: Re-fetch a top-up's QR / payment URL

200.description: Re-fetch the QRIS payload / PayPal checkout URL for a top-up created but not yet paid (created/pending status only).

paymentUrl.description: Provider payment page URL. Omitted when not applicable (e.g. Shopee QRIS path).

qrData.description: Raw QRIS payload string for rendering a QR. Omitted when unavailable.

qrSvg.description: Inline SVG rendering of the QRIS payload. Omitted when QR generation fails.

paypalUrl.description: Resolved PayPal checkout URL. Omitted when not applicable (QRIS path).

200.description: Current status; credits on confirmed payment (idempotent).

get.summary: List per-model budgets + market min asks

200.description: Every available catalog model plus the caller's stored per-model budget caps; one row per model, ordered by provider prefix then upstream model id. The body is the array directly (no envelope).

upstreamCatalogModelId.description: Catalog model id this budget caps.

officialInputPerMtok.description: Official input price per million tokens as a decimal string, e.g. '3.000000'.

officialOutputPerMtok.description: Official output price per million tokens as a decimal string, e.g. '15.000000'.

marketMinAskIn.description: Cheapest active marketplace provider input ask per Mtok (decimal string), or null if no marketplace ask exists.

marketMinAskOut.description: Cheapest active marketplace provider output ask per Mtok (decimal string), or null if no marketplace ask exists.

maxInputPerMtok.description: Caller's saved max input price per Mtok cap (decimal string), or null if not set.

maxOutputPerMtok.description: Caller's saved max output price per Mtok cap (decimal string), or null if not set.

minDiscountPct.description: Caller's saved minimum discount percent off official price (decimal string, e.g. '15.0'), or null if not set.

enabled.description: Whether this budget row is enabled; true when the stored row is enabled or absent.

200.description: Every available catalog model grouped by alias (cross-provider model name). Standalone un-aliased models appear as single-member rows keyed by their upstream model id. Ordered by isAlias desc then alias. The body is the array directly (no envelope).

alias.description: Alias slug, or the upstream_model_id when this is a standalone (un-aliased) model.

isAlias.description: True for a real model alias group; false for a standalone model.

memberModelIds.description: Catalog model ids this budget writes to (N for an alias group, 1 for standalone).

memberCount.description: Number of catalog models in this group.

minDiscountPct.description: Shared min discount percent cap if all members share one stored value (decimal string, e.g. '15.0'); null otherwise (or when no budget is set).

officialInMin.description: Lowest official input price per Mtok across members (decimal string).

officialInMax.description: Highest official input price per Mtok across members (decimal string).

officialOutMin.description: Lowest official output price per Mtok across members (decimal string).

officialOutMax.description: Highest official output price per Mtok across members (decimal string).

upstreamLabels.description: Distinct provider labels backing the members of this group.

put.summary: Set a budget across alias members

200.description: Applied to all members (or deleted when all caps are null).

put.summary: Set or clear a single model budget

200.description: Budget set (or deleted when all caps null).
The caller's combos with their member models, in created-desc order; empty array if none.

maxInputPerMtok.description: decimal string $/Mtok in, or null for unlimited

maxOutputPerMtok.description: decimal string $/Mtok out, or null for unlimited

201.description: Combo created. Body is an empty JSON object (the ok flag is stripped before responding).

200.description: Catalog models the caller can bundle into a combo, ordered by upstream label then model id; empty array if none.

get.summary: List model catalog by upstream (with live asks + my preferences)

200.description: This consumer's upstream/model cards with live marketplace asks and their disable preferences, grouped by upstream. Returns the UpstreamCard[] directly (no envelope).

officialIn.description: Official input price per Mtok as a decimal string, e.g. "3.000000"

officialOut.description: Official output price per Mtok as a decimal string, e.g. "15.000000"

asksIn.description: Live per-provider input ask per Mtok (one entry per live marketplace provider); empty when no supply.

asksOut.description: Live per-provider output ask per Mtok (one entry per live marketplace provider); empty when no supply.

put.summary: Enable/disable an entire upstream for my account

200.description: Preference updated.

put.summary: Enable/disable a single model for my account

200.description: Preference updated (parent-aware collapse/promotion).
Paginated consumer request logs for the range, with filtered/unfiltered counts and rolled-up cost/token/saved totals. Body is the UsageLogPage object.

ask_input_per_mtok.description: Per-Mtok publisher input price the request was served at, decimal string

ask_output_per_mtok.description: Per-Mtok publisher output price the request was served at, decimal string

totalCostUsdc.description: USDC decimal string; rolled-up cost over range

totalSavedUsdc.description: USDC decimal string; rolled-up savings vs official pricing

200.description: Distinct <prefix>/<model> tokens the consumer has hit in range. Body is a JSON array (top-level), not wrapped in an object.
Usage aggregates for the consumer over the range, grouped by alias/model, provider x model, and provider (from usage_daily rollups + live raw slice). Body is the UsageBreakdown object.

key.description: Alias slug when mapped, else upstream_model_id

200.description: Per-user prompt-cache stats for the range, scoped to cache-capable models, plus aggregated totals and hit rate. Body is the UsageCacheStats object.

hitRate.description: cachedTokens / promptTokens clamped to 0..1; 0 when no prompt tokens

get.summary: Live market snapshot (min/max asks + last traded rate per model)

200.description: Live market snapshot: per catalog model the cheapest/highest active provider ask (input & output $/Mtok) plus the most-recent successfully traded blended $/Mtok. Returned directly (no envelope).

ts.description: Snapshot build time as epoch milliseconds (Date.now()).

models.description: Models with activity on at least one side (the live market). Ordered by upstream prefix then upstream_model_id.

minAskIn.description: Cheapest active provider input $/Mtok ask across enabled marketplace providers.

minAskOut.description: Cheapest active provider output $/Mtok ask across enabled marketplace providers.

maxAskIn.description: Highest active provider input $/Mtok ask across enabled marketplace providers.

maxAskOut.description: Highest active provider output $/Mtok ask across enabled marketplace providers.

lastRate.description: Blended $/Mtok of the most recent status='ok' request within the last 24h. Null when no successful trade is recorded.

get.summary: SSE stream of the live market snapshot

200.description: text/event-stream; one snapshot per ~15s.

get.summary: Platform pricing rules (ask cap, fee split)

200.description: Platform pricing knobs read from platform_config (mirrors the public pricing page). Never throws; each value falls back to its own documented default. Returned directly (no envelope).

maxAskPctOfOfficial.description: Platform-wide ceiling on publisher asks, as a fraction of official $/Mtok (0.5 = 50%).

platformFeePct.description: Fraction of each consumer charge the platform keeps (0.2 = 20%).

publisherSharePct.description: Publisher revenue share as a whole-number percent ((1 - fee) x 100), e.g. 80.

200.description: Profile, or null if none yet.

200.description: Profile saved.

200.description: Per-model marketplace asks for the provider's upstream, with official refs, platform cap, today's volume-weighted average settled ask, and the active market floor. Empty array when not owned by the caller.

signupUrl.description: Where to obtain an API key for this upstream, or null.

Publisher earnings balance and consumer (API) balance.

publisherEarningsUsdc.description: USDC decimal string of accrued publisher earnings; '0' when no row exists.

consumerBalanceUsdc.description: USDC decimal string of the consumer/API balance; '0' when no row exists.

200.description: Move publisher earnings into the consumer (API) balance via an instant internal ledger transfer.

transferred.description: The USDC decimal amount that was transferred.

200.description: List the caller's withdrawal/payout requests (most recent 50).

signature.description: On-chain Solana transaction signature once broadcast, else null.

id.description: ID of the newly created withdrawal request.

get.summary: List available models (OpenAI shape, with pricing)
get.description: Returns paid (`prefix/model`), free (`free/slug/model`), and alias (bare name) models. Non-alias models carry a `pricing` object.

200.description: OpenAI-compatible ModelList with an InferHub `pricing` extension per model. Returns {object:"list", data:[...models]}. Pricing rates are JSON numbers (USD per 1M tokens); official_in/official_out are always present when pricing is attached; asks/min_ask are omitted when empty/zero.

id.description: Routable model id, e.g. "<prefix>/<upstream_model_id>", "free/<slug>/<upstream_model_id>", or a bare alias name.

owned_by.description: Provider prefix, "free/<slug>", or "alias" for auto-routed aliases.

supports_cache.description: Whether upstream supports prompt caching for this model.

modality.description: Input modalities, e.g. "text" or "text,image". Omitted when empty.

upstream_label.description: Human-readable upstream label. Omitted when null.

pricing.description: InferHub marketplace pricing extension. Omitted for aliases and models with no ask data and zero official rates.

official_in.description: Upstream official reference price per 1M input tokens (USD).

official_out.description: Upstream official reference price per 1M output tokens (USD).

asks_in.description: Sorted marketplace provider ask prices per 1M input tokens. Omitted when empty.

asks_out.description: Sorted marketplace provider ask prices per 1M output tokens. Omitted when empty.

min_ask_in.description: Cheapest marketplace ask per 1M input tokens. Omitted when 0/null.

min_ask_out.description: Cheapest marketplace ask per 1M output tokens. Omitted when 0/null.

200.description: Consumer account usage object (object:"account.usage"). Returns balance, current window spend, all-time totals, optional session usage, optional top model, and cache status. All top-level keys are always present; session/top_model values may be null.

amount_usdc.description: Current USDC balance, decimal string with 6 fractional digits, e.g. "12.500000".

updated_at.description: RFC3339 UTC timestamp of last balance update; null when balance row is absent.

tz.description: IANA timezone name used for day-boundary computation (default "UTC").

since.description: RFC3339 UTC start of the usage window.

until.description: RFC3339 UTC end of the usage window (server now).

requests.description: Successful request count within the window.

prompt_tokens.description: Input tokens consumed within the window.

completion_tokens.description: Output tokens consumed within the window.

spend_usdc.description: Window USDC spend, decimal string with 6 fractional digits.
Lifetime USDC spend, decimal string with 6 fractional digits.

session.description: Per-conversation usage for session_id (or the user's most recent conversation if session_id omitted). Null when session=0/false is set, when no session_id/row exists, or when the session has zero requests.

requests.description: Successful request count for this session.

spend_usdc.description: Session USDC spend, decimal string with 6 fractional digits.

since.description: RFC3339 UTC timestamp of first session request; null when session has no rows.

until.description: RFC3339 UTC timestamp of last session request; null when session has no rows.

top_model.description: Most-used model all-time. Null when the user has no usage rows.

model.description: Model id of the top all-time model.

requests.description: All-time successful request count for this model.

tokens.description: All-time token total (in+out) for this model.

spend_usdc.description: All-time USDC spend for this model, decimal string with 6 fractional digits.

cached.description: Whether this response was served from the in-process cache.

200.description: OpenAI chat completion (SSE when stream=true).
Anthropic message (SSE when stream=true; native passthrough for claude upstream).
Responses object (native for codex/grok with hosted tools; translated otherwise).
